title: map
description: Workspace orientation — replaces ls -R and orientation greps (SDD 9.2). A pruned directory skeleton at Tier 0, per-file symbol outlines when the index is warm, an import-graph summary (top fan-in/fan-out modules) on the overview, detected entry points (package.json main/bin, src/main.*, Cargo [[bin]]), index health, and the installed-plugin inventory with trust labels. In a Cargo workspace, ranked crate rows (one per member: roles, edition, entry points, features, member dependencies with importing-file counts when the index is warm, dependents) sit between the overview and the tree, and the overview carries a cargo summary. Results carry a short ttlMs keyed to index generation.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory to map; "." is the workspace root.

depth.description: Tree depth below `path`. Entries deeper than this are folded into their ancestor directory's counts.

detail.description: skeleton: tree only. outline: adds compressed per-file symbol outlines when the index is warm. full: outlines without the per-file symbol cap (the budget still trims).
